name: radio-group-choice-card
title: Radio Group: Choice Card
description: Use `FieldLabel` to wrap the entire `Field` for a clickable card-style selection.

files.content:
import {
  Field,
  FieldContent,
  FieldDescription,
  FieldItem,
  FieldLabel,
} from "@/registry/erbium/ui/field";
import { RadioGroup, RadioGroupItem } from "@/registry/erbium/ui/radio-group";

export function RadioGroupChoiceCard() {
  return (
    <Field className="max-w-sm">
      <RadioGroup defaultValue="plus">
        <FieldItem variant="card" orientation="horizontal">
          <FieldContent>
            <FieldLabel>Plus</FieldLabel>
            <FieldDescription>For individuals and small teams.</FieldDescription>
          </FieldContent>
          <RadioGroupItem value="plus" />
        </FieldItem>
        <FieldItem variant="card" orientation="horizontal">
          <FieldContent>
            <FieldLabel>Pro</FieldLabel>
            <FieldDescription>For growing businesses.</FieldDescription>
          </FieldContent>
          <RadioGroupItem value="pro" />
        </FieldItem>
        <FieldItem variant="card" orientation="horizontal">
          <FieldContent>
            <FieldLabel>Enterprise</FieldLabel>
            <FieldDescription>For large teams and enterprises.</FieldDescription>
          </FieldContent>
          <RadioGroupItem value="enterprise" />
        </FieldItem>
      </RadioGroup>
    </Field>
  );
}
